# The Unified Remote Continuation & Control Plane for Official AI Agents

================================================================================
1. SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE & TOPOLOGY
================================================================================

```text
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│               Developer Workstation (Local)             │
│                                                         │
│   Official Agent Runtimes (Claude Code / OpenAI Codex)  │
│                           ▲                             │
│                    (Native Protocol)                    │
│                           ▼                             │
│                  agenthub-runner.exe                    │
│     (Single-binary, pure Rust 2024 daemon / runner)     │
│             │                             │             │
│   (Embedded Local Web)           (Outbound TLS/WSS)     │
│             ▼                             ▼             │
│     http://127.0.0.1:4200                 │             │
└───────────────────────────────────────────┼─────────────┘
                                            │
                                            ▼
                              ┌───────────────────────────┐
                              │    Self-Hosted Gateway    │
                              │ (Fastify / TypeScript)    │
                              │  - Auth & Device Registry │
                              │  - Durable Event Outbox   │
                              │  - Command Ledger & Router│
                              └─────────────┬─────────────┘
                                            │
                                            ▼ (WSS / SSE / HTTPS)
                              ┌───────────────────────────┐
                              │     Remote Web Client     │
                              │ (React 19 / PWA / Next.js)│
                              │  - Live Streaming Console │
                              │  - Permission Approval UI │
                              │  - Emergency Stop Control │
                              └───────────────────────────┘
```

Component Roles:
1. agenthub-runner (Runner / agenthubd):
   - The authoritative local session control plane written in Rust.
   - Manages official agent child processes via native stdio/JSON-RPC protocols.
   - Single-writer guarantee: Exactly one process holds writer locks per session.
   - Embedded local web server serving CDS / magpie-ported responsive dashboard.
   - Outbound-only TLS client: Connects to self-hosted Gateway; no inbound NAT/firewall holes.

2. Gateway:
   - Self-hosted state routing and event persistence hub.
   - Handles tenant auth, device public-key challenge, and command idempotency.
   - Stores session event timelines with sequence ordering and durable watermarks.
   - Does NOT execute LLM inference loops; does NOT store LLM provider credentials.

3. Web Client (PWA):
   - Responsive web interface designed for desktop browsers, tablets, and mobile phones.
   - Consumes live SSE/WebSocket streams for token output, tool executions, and diffs.
   - Provides touch-friendly one-tap approval for CLI shell commands and file edits.

================================================================================
2. CORE RELIABILITY & PROTOCOL ENVELOPES
================================================================================

2.1 Command Idempotency & Lifecycle States
Remote commands sent from the Web Client adhere to strict state transitions:
  QUEUED -> ACCEPTED -> EXECUTING -> COMPLETED / FAILED / INTERRUPTED
- Every command carries an opaque `client_command_id` (UUID v4).
- Resending a command with the same ID returns HTTP 202 with existing ledger receipt without duplicate execution.

2.2 Three-Tier Session Semantics:
- `create`: Spawns a new native session under the runner's management.
- `resume`: Binds an existing historical session to the runner's control plane.
- `discover`: Reads metadata (title, model, timestamps) strictly as read-only candidates; does NOT claim ownership.

2.3 Privacy Redaction Policy:
- Workstation absolute paths are hashed into stable `workspace_id` fingerprints.
- Shell commands and prompts in unmanaged candidate discoveries are masked.
- Auth credentials, cookies, and tokens are strictly excluded from network sync batches.

================================================================================
3. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS & TROUBLESHOOTING (FAQ)
================================================================================

Q1: Why does agenthub-runner use outbound-only connections?
A1: Developers running agents on local laptops or private networks often do not have static public IPs or port-forwarding access. Exposing local ports introduces security attack surfaces. With outbound-only TLS/WSS, the workstation securely phones home to the Gateway.

Q2: Can AgentHub attach to an already running CLI session in another terminal?
A2: No. Official agent runtimes (Claude Code, Codex) do not provide external attach APIs for active terminals. To enable remote control, the session must be started via or resumed into agenthub-runner (`agenthub-runner daemon` or `agenthub-runner web`).

Q3: What happens if network disconnects during an agent run?
A3: The local agent runtime continues executing uninterrupted. The runner buffers outgoing events in its durable local outbox journal. Once the connection to the Gateway is re-established, buffered events are synced via sequence watermarks with zero event loss.

Q4: What models and providers are supported?
A4: Official Claude Code (Anthropic Claude 3.5 / 3.7 / 5) and OpenAI Codex runtime environments. Future providers are integrated via native CLI capability probing.
